## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive. Equities strong but mixed signals: SPY ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.54% | 1M: +4.91%) and QQQ ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.17% | 1M: +6.30%) vs pockets of weakness in Energy and Staples (XLE BELOW TREND (1W: -3.94% | 1M: -3.07%); XLP BELOW TREND (1W: -2.08% | 1M: -4.08%)), with volatility easing VXX BELOW TREND (1W: -7.36% | 1M: -9.64%) ↓ falling — supports a neutral read.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Volatility falling: VXX BELOW TREND (1W: -7.36% | 1M: -9.64%) ↓ falling. Credit modestly constructive: HYG ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.34% | 1M: +1.76%) and LQD ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.41% | 1M: +1.57%) → flat. Sector divergence: XLE BELOW TREND (1W: -3.94% | 1M: -3.07%) showing weakness.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Neutral: TLT BELOW TREND (1W: -0.10% | 1M: -0.04%) → flat and credit spreads modestly tight with HYG/LQD stable, so financial conditions are not signaling a decisive hawkish or dovish swing.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Tech leading: XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.08% | 1M: +8.44%). Financials showing strength: Financials ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.67% | 1M: +9.92%). Energy lagging: XLE BELOW TREND (1W: -3.94% | 1M: -3.07%); style mixed with Growth/Tech leadership but breadth still only moderate.

5. US vs Global?
US leads: SPY ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.54% | 1M: +4.91%). EM outperformance notable: EEM ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.91% | 1M: +6.54%), China neutral: FXI NEUTRAL (1W: +1.46% | 1M: +0.00%).

6. Speculative Appetite?
Speculative risk-on: ARKK ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.11% | 1M: +7.52%) and IBIT ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.29% | 1M: +1.48%) show appetite for high-beta/innovation, while IWM ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.42% | 1M: +8.42%) confirms small-cap participation.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Industrial/metal cyclical strength: CPER ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.70% | 1M: +4.40%). Gold in RECOVERY: GLD RECOVERY (1W: +1.36% | 1M: -4.34%) and Silver RECOVERY: SLV RECOVERY (1W: +6.48% | 1M: -1.88%), signaling selective safe-haven flows and profit-taking.

8. Energy Trend?
Energy under pressure: XLE BELOW TREND (1W: -3.94% | 1M: -3.07%) and UNG BELOW TREND (1W: -4.51% | 1M: -13.35%) ↓ falling; oil proxies remain weak (BNO BELOW TREND (1W: -1.46% | 1M: -0.71%)).

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
Confirmed: Broad equity momentum — SPY and QQQ BOTH ABOVE TREND. Divergences are MINOR: several commodity and region ETFs in RECOVERY/CORRECTION (GLD RECOVERY, SLV RECOVERY, USO CORRECTION) but core equity leadership is intact — no MAJOR divergence across SPY/XLK/XLF/TLT.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor exposure to Tech and cyclical growth buckets (XLK ABOVE TREND; IWM ABOVE TREND) while reducing exposure to Energy and defensive staples (XLE BELOW TREND; XLP BELOW TREND); monitor gold (GLD RECOVERY) and natural gas (UNG BELOW TREND) for volatility spillovers.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: Technology — XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.08% | 1M: +8.44%) if momentum holds. BEARISH: Energy — XLE BELOW TREND (1W: -3.94% | 1M: -3.07%) until sector breadth improves.

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: Copper — CPER ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.70% | 1M: +4.40%) as a cyclical gauge. BEARISH: Natural gas — UNG BELOW TREND (1W: -4.51% | 1M: -13.35%) and oil proxies (BNO BELOW TREND) remain vulnerable.

13. Key Levels?
VXX (1W: -7.36% | 1M: -9.64%) ~ 20 marks complacency threshold to watch. HYG (1W: +0.34% | 1M: +1.76%) / LQD (1W: +0.41% | 1M: +1.57%) stability critical for risk appetite. XLK vs XLF cross (Tech vs Financials) around current spread to watch for style rotation.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive, with equities and tech showing strength while energy and staples lag. Favor tech and small-cap exposure; key risk is the narrower breadth and commodity/sector divergences to monitor.
